narrative.text: The University of Ashenmere is the only comprehensive higher education institution in Veltria. It was built to serve six thousand students. It currently enrolls twelve thousand. Lecture halls designed for eighty students hold one hundred and sixty. Library shelves are three decades out of date. The two largest provinces — Kravenstal and Thornfeld — have no university at all. The expansion proposal would enlarge the Ashenmere campus and establish two regional colleges, doubling capacity to twenty-four thousand students.

Twenty-five million ₭ over ten weeks. The long-term economic return is substantial — an educated workforce attracts investment, increases productivity, and raises wages. But the return takes a decade to materialize. In budget terms, this is an investment in the Veltria of 1973, not the Veltria of 1964. At some point around week five, the project will present a difficult policy choice regarding admission standards that has significant political implications.

This project will require a decision on admission policies at its midpoint — the classic tension between merit-based admission favored by the elite and regional/minority quotas demanded by the Dravenni and reformist factions.

choices.text: "Approve the university expansion. Twenty-five million ₭ from the education and infrastructure budgets. Every child in this country who can meet the academic standard deserves a place at a university, regardless of where they were born. The regional colleges are not optional — they are the mechanism by which higher education stops being an Ashenmere privilege and becomes a Veltrian right."

"Defer. The university expansion is important — I believe in it. But twenty-five million ₭ is significant, and I want the regional college locations finalized and the admission policy framework established before we break ground. We will revisit this in the next budget cycle."

"The state cannot afford to subsidize higher education for everyone. The University of Ashenmere will continue to serve those who can qualify through existing channels. Students who want university education beyond that can apply to institutions in Arcturia or Lytheira. The government's priority is primary and secondary education, where the impact is broader."
